# proxmox_node_syslog (Data Source)

Reads node syslog entries from `GET /nodes/{node}/syslog`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "proxmox_node_syslog" "recent" {
  node  = "pve-1"
  limit = 20
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String) Cluster node.

### Optional

- `limit` (Number) Maximum entries, default 100.
- `service` (String) Only entries of this service.
- `since` (String) Lower time bound.
- `until` (String) Upper time bound.

### Read-Only

- `entries` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--entries))

<a id="nestedatt--entries"></a>
### Nested Schema for `entries`

Read-Only:

- `line` (Number)
- `text` (String)
